assets.name: station-painting
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Paint a visibly NEW country railway station artwork, the registration master for four separated game planes. 1536 × 1024 landscape 3:2. Reference 1 sets ONLY the camera, anchor locations and scale, never reuse its actual material art or scenery design. Reference 2 sets the hand-painted coloured-pencil and textured matte gouache Miniature World style. New design: a small coastal railway stop on a bright day. Quiet powder-blue sky, a distant sliver of blue sea between rolling sage coastal hills and a few wind-shaped pine groves, low dry-stone boundary wall. On the far right, a honey limestone station with weathered blue-gray slate roof, brick chimney and sage-green wooden canopy. A painted blue-green iron gantry with restrained warm brass collars and EXACTLY EIGHT DARK signal housings and open X-braced lattice. Change all surface brushwork and colors, only lock the geometry. Clean slate and warm-stone platform on a buff stone retaining wall, two straight, parallel silver railway rails over gravel, a lively low verge of coastal grasses with pale violet and white flowers. Fixed anchors in source pixels: dark round signal glass at [294,218],[406,216],[517,216],[628,214],[740,214],[851,212],[963,212],[1074,210], about 52px across with thin black hoods; gantry legs at x230 and x1135 with footing at y680; platform ledge near y675, far rail top y779, near rail top y812, grass-gravel transition around y883. Keep a clear opening at upper right x1100–1450 y100–360 for a separate clue card. Station stays cropped on the right. Geometry must register to reference 1, no zoom, no perspective shift. Clear edge-to-edge background and foreground. No trains, people, smoke, clouds, logos, text or signs. No interface.

assets.name: train-body
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Completely repaint reference 1 as a DISTINCT coastal two-carriage passenger train for Departure Signal. Match the second reference's hand-painted matte gouache and coloured-pencil texture. New paint scheme: deep ink-blue lower body, a broad warm ivory band through the windows, golden amber doors, a thin rust-red waist stripe and a softly weathered slate roof. Warm yellow headlamp. New painted details including modest bolts, riveted side panels and blue-glazed windows; friendly but no face or mouth. Keep the reference 1 completely side-on silhouette, right-facing cab nose, two connected cars, original exact body width and height, wheel arches, four bogies and wheel center spacing, roof line and front roof vent, with the same wide placement and padding. Same empty transparent space under all eight open arches. No wheels at all, no ground or cast shadow, no labels, text, letters or numbers. Single complete sprite on genuine transparency, preserve the very wide shape and negative space.

assets.name: wheel
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one visibly new wheel for the coastal Departure Signal train. Soft matte painted gouache and pencil in the style of reference 2. Spokes must read at small size; open transparency between all six spokes. Perfect circle, centered face-on, broad clear margin. One single wheel on genuine transparent alpha; no perspective, text, shadow, streak or floor.
